items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A few names come to mind if I try hard. There was the alto saxophonist, whose name was Porter Kilbert.

ctx.x: Who all was in the Benny Carter Orchestra with you that you remember?
A few names come to mind if I try hard. There was the alto saxophonist, whose name was Porter Kilbert.
